content: तिर्यच्, तिर्यञ्च {%a.%} (तिरश्ची {%f.%}, rarely तिर्यञ्ची) .²1 Oblique, transverse, horizontal, awry; तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधस्ताच्च व्यापको महिमा हरेः <ls>Ku. 6. 71</ls>. .²2 Crooked, curved. .²3 Crossing over, traversing. .²4 Winding. .²5 Lying in the middle or between. --{%m., n.%} .²1 An animal (going horizontally as distinguished from man who walks erect), a lower or irrational animal; बन्धाय दिव्ये न तिरश्चि कश्चित् पाशादिरासादितपौरुषः स्यात् <ls>N. 3. 20</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 48</ls>. .²2 A bird. .²3 (With Jainas) The organic world, or plants.
